描述_EN: the term porcelain refers to ceramics made from a mixture containing a clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, whiteness after firing and fine texture. ding wares were among the earliest true porcelains to be made made in china, and indeed in the world. it would have been kept well away from the kitchen in order to protect the salt from absorbing any cooking odours or fumes. this lidded jar is an example of ding ware, made in hebei province in china during the northern song dynasty (960-1127). the shape of this jar suggests that it was used in a practical way, for storing salt needed for the preparation of brick tea.
描述_ZN: 瓷器一词是指由一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做petuntse的白色石头的混合物制成的陶瓷，这种混合物在高温下烧制。 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、烧制后的白度和精细的纹理。 丁器是中国乃至世界上最早的真正的瓷器之一。 它应该被放在远离厨房的地方，以保护盐不吸收任何烹饪的气味或烟雾。 这个盖子是中国北宋时期河北制造的鼎器的一个例子（960-1127）。 这个罐子的形状表明它是以一种实用的方式使用的，用于储存制备砖茶所需的盐。
